items.summary: Recommendation: approve only report-only evidence baselines for findyourlostpets.com, dumbsluts.com, and eastcoastrappers.com. Reject production work, financial claims, credential/configuration changes, spending, and high-priority queue work because attribution, telemetry, and measured outcomes are insufficient. Each report must identify one reversible hypothesis, metric, sample threshold, stop rule, and rollback notes.
